name: Kuresato Nagi
source: A high school student who aims to become a voice actress. After dying in the accident together with Shuu, and ending up in "Conservatory", it is found out that Nagi is actually tone-deaf.
translation: A high school student who aims to become a voice actress. After dying in the accident together with Shuu, and ending up in "Conservatory", it is found out that Nagi is actually tone-deaf.
